messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "report drowsiness, agitation, feeding problems, or poor weight gain in nursing baby"
set: ["report drowsiness, agitation, feeding problems, or poor weight gain in nursing baby", "monitor baby for poor weight gain", "monitor baby for poor feeding", "notify doctor if nursing baby has slow weight gain", "report weight gain to doctor", "notify doctor if nursing baby has feeding problems", "swelling or rapid weight gain", "report weight changes to doctor", "notify doctor if nursing baby shows drowsiness", "child's dose may change with weight gain or loss", "tell your doctor about weight gain or increasing breathlessness", "dose needs may change if you gain or lose weight", "different while nursing", "report urinating less than usual or blood in urine", "stop using and call doctor at once if swelling or rapid weight gain", "child taking escitalopram should be checked for height and weight gain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
